narrative.overview:
Every surface is a page from the file an outsider would keep on you. The field is manila folder stock with paper fiber; content sits on bond sheets that lie on the folder and cast a soft paper shadow; everything printed on them is carbon ink. Typed exhibits are set in Courier Prime, the body in Public Sans (the U.S. government face), and headings in condensed Archivo, the way a stamp or a form title would be. Classification bands run across the top (and on the landing page, the bottom) of every surface.

Structure comes from rules, not fills. Panels are ruled boxes; tables are ledgers with a heavy ink head rule; summaries are typed ledgers, never hero-metric tiles. Color is almost entirely absent: one stamp red marks the single thing to fix first, carbon blue marks focus and nothing else, and severity hues ride on edges and bands while the words stay in ink. Evidence is shown in place and annotated where it sits (a header line, a dotted leader, a note), never summarized into a tinted card.

Density is that of a working document: compact 13 to 14px text in the app, generous 80 to 112px section passes on the landing page. The Persuade surface may tilt and stack sheets; the Operate surfaces lie flat on one sheet under die-cut folder tabs.
keyCharacteristics: Manila field, bond sheets, carbon ink; square corners everywhere.
Rules and line style carry structure and category; fills are reserved.
Stamp red appears once per surface, on the P0.
Condensed Archivo for titles and stamps, Public Sans for prose, Courier Prime for anything collected.
Folder tabs are navigation; classification bands frame the page.

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Stamp red marks the P0 and nothing else. A surface carries one red stamp, on the one item to fix first; the same item may repeat its red in a P0 chip or Critical badge, but no second item, heading, button, or decoration ever takes red.

rules.name: The Edge-Not-Ink Rule
rules.body: Severity color rides edges, swatches, bars, and lines; the words are ink. Never set severity labels or body text in a severity hue.

rules.name: The Untinted Panel Rule
rules.body: Panels, cards, and memos are bond or transparent with ink rules. No tinted fills to group or signal; hover tints on ledger rows (`manila` at 10 to 15%) are state, not structure.

rules.name: The Line-Not-Hue Rule
rules.body: Categories that are not severity (environment, priority above P0, inactive paths) are told by line style: solid fill for prod, solid outline for staging, dashed for dev, dotted for unknown.

rules.name: The Typed-Evidence Rule
rules.body: If it was collected (a hostname, header, timestamp, advisory ID, package version), it is set in Courier Prime. If it was written (a summary, a remediation, a description), it is Public Sans.

rules.name: The Condensed Title Rule
rules.body: Display, headline, title, and stamp text are Archivo at weight 800, condensed (78% for titles, 70 to 85% inside stamps and sheet headings). Never set a title in the body face.

rules.name: The Paper-On-Folder Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "a sheet of paper is lying on the folder." Nothing on a sheet casts a shadow.

dos: Do put every content surface on a bond sheet over the grained manila field, with the Sheet shadow.
Do build structure from ink rules: 2px for heads and page titles, 1px hairlines at 15 to 30% for dividers.
Do set collected data in Courier Prime and written prose in Public Sans.
Do carry severity on borders, swatches, bars, and edges, with ink labels.
Do tell non-severity categories by line style (filled, solid, dashed, dotted).
Do print the most urgent path in full ink and fade the rest to 30% ink until hovered.
Do annotate evidence in place with leaders and badges rather than summarizing it elsewhere.
Do frame every surface with a classification band stating the passive, authorized scope.
Do give every motion a reduced-motion state that shows the finished result.
donts: Don't use stamp red for anything but the P0: no red buttons, headings, links, or second stamps.
Don't fill a panel, card, or callout with a tint to group or flag it.
Don't round corners; the only non-rectangular forms are the die-cut tab and the drawn stamp.
Don't cast shadows inside a sheet or use hard offset shadows; the only shadows are Sheet and the button Lift.
Don't set severity labels or body copy in a severity hue.
Don't set titles in Public Sans or uncondensed Archivo.
